scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted mandatory closing branding 'thank you for choosing s-net' and customer satisfaction survey request.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (42s at [02:30] and 44s at [07:45]) without hold announcements or thanks.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent offered zero restatement of customer's stolen handset report, moving directly to switch operations.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent rudely blamed customer for being mugged, stating Kyle only had his own carelessness to blame for an expensive phone theft.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding remote wiping, passcode locks, or banking app exposure before processing the equipment blacklist.

grader.scenario: Stolen mobile handset on public transit; immediate IMEI blacklisting and SIM suspension; agent omits survey and closing branding, leaves two unmanaged silences > 30s, offers zero paraphrasing, snaps rudely blaming customer carelessness, and asks zero probing questions
grader.notes: The agent barred the mobile phone number and blacklisted the device IMEI across the national CEIR database following a theft on a commuter train. However, the agent failed Branding and Survey Check by omitting 'thank you for choosing s-net' and the survey, failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 44s at [07:45]), failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the theft report, failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by rudely blaming Kyle's carelessness ('If you left an expensive iPhone sitting in an open pocket while distracted on a crowded train, you only have your own carelessness to blame for opportunistic theft'), and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding remote wiping, banking app locks, or passcodes.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [15:45] Agent: 'All security actions complete. Good afternoon and take care. Goodbye.' - Closing lacks mandatory S-Net branding and survey mention.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 42 seconds at [02:30] while querying HLR switch, and a second unmanaged silence of 44 seconds at [07:45] while updating CEIR blacklist.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:10] Agent verified full billing address ('19 Millmead Terrace, Guildford') and security question ('mother\'s maiden name') within first 240 seconds.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent gave no restatement of customer's stolen handset problem statement, moving directly to command entry.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [13:40] Agent accurately recorded police crime reference BTP-4491-08 and reconfirmed delivery address without redundant re-asking.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [06:15] Agent: 'If you left an expensive iPhone sitting in an open pocket while distracted on a crowded train, you only have your own carelessness to blame for opportunistic theft.' - Insulting and victim-blaming comment.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked zero probing questions regarding whether device was eSIM or physical SIM, whether remote wipe was active, or whether device passcode was compromised.
